records.sourceAnchor: India Cine Hub incentive calculator and international-project guide reconciled with the Ministry incentive guideline and current permission route
observations: India Cine Hub is established by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting as a single-window facilitation and clearance route, managed by NFDC and operated through the official portal for international filming permissions.

The current international-project guide accepts feature films, TV/web shows and series, and reality TV/web shows and series. It states that the online application requires a non-refundable INR equivalent of USD 225 and that documentaries, AV commercials and music videos are not accepted through this route.

The route requires a detailed script/synopsis or reality-show concept, crew passport details, Indian shooting locations and period, temporary-import equipment details, applicable no-objection material and an official co-production agreement where the project is an international co-production under a treaty.

Permission normally takes no more than three weeks after all requisite documents are submitted, but Ministry of Home Affairs or Ministry of External Affairs consultation can extend the timeline. The permission letter does not erase separate local authority, location, monument, forest, railway, animal, visa or other permissions.

The indexed Ministry incentive guideline describes up to 40% of qualifying production expenditure incurred in India, with a base reimbursement and conditional Indian-manpower and Significant Indian Content bonuses, subject to an indexed INR 30 crore cap. These figures are not yet publication-ready because the exact current guideline must be captured and reconciled.

The incentive calculator estimate, permission approval and reimbursement claim are separate stages. A portal estimate is not a sanction, reimbursement approval or guaranteed payout, and qualifying expenditure, claimant, claim timing, bonus evidence and cap treatment must follow the governing guideline.

The Ministry guideline PDF timed out during the current source check, while the indexed India Cine Hub guideline copy returned 404. The current ICH permission route is live, but the guideline evidence remains a source-resolution and amendment blocker.

UdyamVeda may prepare the production, permission and evidence checklist, but the producer or authorised Indian production services/line-production entity must use its own account, declarations, documents, fee payment and claim route.
